experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Full Stack Developer in training, with hands-on experience in web and mobile projects (Android/Flutter).

ricardo_teran.description:
As a developer, I was responsible for the creation and maintenance of solutions within the Odoo ecosystem, aimed at optimizing key business processes. I designed and implemented, from scratch, a custom module for managing the manufacturing processes of a paint management company, as well as tailored reports for the analysis and management of operational data. 

 I also participated in the development of the Point of Sale (POS) module, where I diagnosed and resolved issues in the integration with fiscal printers, contributing to system stability and the continuity of the client's operations. Throughout this process, I also gained experience in project management using agile methodologies, employing Kanban boards for task organization and tracking.

ucla.description: I designed and developed multiple software projects as part of my university education, applying principles of software architecture, data structures and algorithms, relational databases, and full stack development. I worked on web and mobile solutions using microservices architectures, design patterns, and software engineering best practices, such as version control, unit testing, and agile development methodologies. This training strengthened my technical judgment when facing changing requirements and specific business needs, similar to what occurs in real-world industry projects.

watery.title: Watery
watery.description: Android application with a widget that automates water price calculations (barrels) by extracting the official Central Bank of Venezuela (BCV) exchange rate through web scraping.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: Personal website built to present my developer profile in a professional and memorable way. Features bilingual support (ES/EN), smooth animations and an interactive 3D hero scene.

university_bank.title: University Bank
university_bank.description: Frontend application for a fictitious university bank built with React and Redux. It features a complete online banking experience, including user authentication, contact management, account movements, and simulated money transfers.
